source_statement: Let ABC be a triangle with ∠A = 60◦ . Line ℓ intersects segments AB and AC and splits triangle ABC into an equilateral triangle and a quadrilateral. Let X and Y be on ℓ such that lines BX and CY are perpendicular to ℓ. Given that AB = 20 and AC = 22, compute XY .

clause_ledger.source: line l cuts AB,AC and leaves an equilateral triangle plus quadrilateral
clause_ledger.dsl: U on AB and V on AC with AUV equilateral; l=Line(U,V)

clause_ledger.source: BX and CY perpendicular to l; X,Y on l
